svg.title: Red Relief over White
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-05-2015/lightbox/works/red-relief-over-white-2013-39470; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
